dct_description_sm: These documents were collected to supplement archival and oral history research into the Inuit experience with mining at Rankin Inlet, Nunavut. R.G. Williamson was an important figure in Rankin Inlet, due to his connections with both the federal government and the Inuit community. His archives contain documents relating to his work at Rankin Inlet, post-closure economic development activities, and studies of Inuit relocation and cultural adjustment.
